These fixtures are reduced from public retailer product pages retrieved on 2026-09-18. They contain product data only, without cookies, account information, navigation, recommendations, or pricing data. They deliberately preserve actual embedded product structures, source image URLs, and size labels.

ASOS: product 209696517 (black rib midi dress). Boohoo: GZZ26440 (black and hot pink lace dress, all listed sizes sold out). PrettyLittleThing: YDD23636 (multi beauty advent calendar, one size).

`scripts/capture-fixtures.ts` regenerates these fixtures from raw samples in ignored `.local/samples/`; the script does not download samples. Tests additionally exercise malformed JSON, missing fields, duplicate images, category redirects, and challenge pages.
